maddeler.e:
أسترجم (form X)
# أَسْتَرْجِمُ (ʔastarjimu) /ʔas.tar.d͡ʒi.mu/: first-person singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَرْجَمَ (istarjama)
# أَسْتَرْجِمَ (ʔastarjima) /ʔas.tar.d͡ʒi.ma/: first-person singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَرْجَمَ (istarjama)
# أَسْتَرْجِمْ (ʔastarjim) /ʔas.tar.d͡ʒim/: first-person singular non-past active jussive of اِسْتَرْجَمَ (istarjama)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
